items.exampleEn: We use a filter to clean our drinking water.
items.exampleZh: 我們用濾水器讓飲用水變乾淨。

items.exampleEn: The farmers rest in a small hut during lunch.
items.exampleZh: 農夫們午餐時在一間小屋休息。

items.exampleEn: Open a tin of beans for lunch.

items.exampleEn: Keep the bread away from damp places.
items.exampleZh: 麵包要放在遠離潮濕的地方。

items.exampleEn: Fill the basin with warm water.
Could you hand me the hammer, please?
The farmer set up a stall by the road.
items.exampleZh: 那位農夫在路邊擺了一個攤位。

items.exampleEn: The lodge by the lake has only six rooms.
items.exampleZh: 湖邊那間山莊只有六個房間。

items.sentenceEn: The basement smells damp after the rain.
items.sentenceZh: 下過雨後，地下室聞起來濕濕的。

items.audioEn: Our tent was wet, so we spent the night in the hut instead.
items.audioZh: 我們的帳篷濕了，所以改在小屋裡過夜。

items.sentenceEn: My father keeps his tools in an old cookie tin.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸爸把工具放在一個舊餅乾盒裡。

items.sentenceEn: Change the coffee filter every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 每天早上換一次咖啡濾紙。

items.stemEn: He hit the nail with a ____.
Don't wear that shirt; it's still ____ from the wash.
items.stemZh: 別穿那件襯衫，剛洗完還濕濕的。

items.passageEn: Last summer, we spent three days at a lodge in the mountains. The lodge was simple but impressive, with a big wooden hall. Behind it, there was a small hut where the owner kept his tools, like a hammer and some saws. Every morning, we washed our faces in a metal basin. The air was cool and damp, so our clothes never dried. On the way home, we stopped at a roadside stall and bought a tin of local tea.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們在山上的一間山莊住了三天。山莊很簡樸，但令人印象深刻，有一個大大的木造大廳。後面有一間小屋，主人把鐵鎚、鋸子等工具放在裡面。每天早上，我們在一個金屬臉盆裡洗臉。空氣涼爽又潮濕，所以我們的衣服一直都乾不了。回家路上，我們在一個路邊攤停下來，買了一罐當地的茶。

questions.questionZh: 每天早上他們在哪裡洗臉？
回家路上他們買了什麼？
